_doc: Pictures of the WordPress-era blog articles (user, 2026-10-07). The original uploads (wp-content) answer 410 and the WordPress backup holds no 2023+ media, so every picture is either the original file found locally ("exact") or a fitting own photo. Key = URL slug. 'slots' replace the article's original tags in order of their file name stem ('orig'); 'cover' is the card + og:image. Files are made by scripts/import-blog-images.mjs into public/blog-images//. Source roots: CZ/VB/PA = OneDrive Desktop/Neu Homepage (Clown Zauberer, …/Verarbeitet mit Übershcrift für Blog, Pantomime), HP = Travail Stand März 2023/Marketing/Fotos/Homepage 2023 (the 2023 WordPress uploads), TR = Travail …/Marketing/Fotos, DL = Downloads, CZN = CZ/Zeitungsartikel.
